purpose: Real geometry and fixed features for complete-room inputs/evaluation; not professional decision supervision.
pre_derivation_requirements: Join using site/building/floor/plan/unit/area; apartment_id alone is not globally unique.
Group by site and repeated plan/geometry before allocating any split; record unresolved cross-site duplicates.
Keep all cases unallocated until that audit; do not treat public corpus as sealed test automatically.
Source webpage example site127 is already exposed and must be development-only if encountered.
Heights may be defaults per source; source simulations do not imply actual resident comfort or current installed state.
Record source-to-native geometry mapping, installation unknowns and researcher task assumptions before inference.
derived_dataset_overlap_warning: MSD and Neufert4.0 derive from SwissDwellings; do not treat them as independent data when combining.
